steps.title: Authorization to Work in Canada
steps.detail: Obtain and maintain valid proof of Canadian citizenship, permanent residency, or a work/study permit that authorizes nursing practice in Ontario. CNO requires this document to be unexpired when submitted. Without it, CNO holds the application open for up to two years, or registers Aida with a condition preventing practice. Confirm current immigration status before submitting the CNO application.

steps.title: Educational Credential Assessment (ECA)
steps.detail: Submit nursing transcripts and educational documents to a CNO-approved ECA provider — WES, ICAS, or ICES (BCIT). CNO must receive the ECA report directly from the provider before Aida can submit a registration application. Allow approximately 3–5 months for processing. Target submission: 2026-10-01; expected CNO receipt: 2027-02-01. CNO also accepts NNAS expedited reports prepared by CGFNS/TruMerit. No expiry period applies to the ECA report itself.

steps.title: Language Proficiency Test (IELTS Academic / CELBAN / OET)
steps.detail: Complete an accepted English-language proficiency test. CELBAN is nursing-specific and widely used. The result must be valid (within 24 months) at the date CNO makes its registration decision — not merely at the date of application. Recommended test date: 2026-11-01. A 2026-11-01 result expires 2028-11-01, providing a comfortable buffer through the anticipated registration decision in mid-2027. Do NOT test too early: a result taken before 2025-09-14 would already be expired today.

steps.title: Evidence of Practice (within the past three years)
steps.detail: Demonstrate paid RN practice, or completion of nursing education, within the three years immediately preceding the registration decision. For practice outside Ontario, Aida's employer must send a Verification of Nursing Practice form and her Philippine Nursing Board regulator must send a Verification of Registration form directly to CNO. Ensure these cover practice up to at least 2024-09-14 (three years before the expected 2027 decision window). Gather documents now while employment records are accessible.

steps.title: Transition to Practice (TTP) Requirement
steps.detail: All internationally educated RN applicants must meet the CNO Transition to Practice requirement. Options: (a) a Canadian nursing degree/diploma, (b) nursing practice in Canada within the past three years, or (c) a CNO-approved TTP course (valid five years from completion) or a school Education Pathway program (valid three years). As Aida is newly arrived from the Philippines, she will most likely need to complete a CNO-approved TTP course. Research approved TTP providers early — popular cohorts fill quickly. Target TTP completion: 2027-03-01. A 2027-03-01 completion date gives a valid TTP until 2032-03-01, well within the registration decision window.

steps.title: CNO Registration Application
steps.detail: Once CNO has received the ECA report (expected 2027-02-01), Aida submits the registration application herself directly to CNO. The application triggers CNO's review of all requirements: language proficiency, evidence of practice, TTP, authorization to work, and the criminal record check. Target application submission: 2027-02-15.

steps.title: Jurisprudence Examination (RN)
steps.detail: Open-book, online exam covering Ontario nursing laws, CNO by-laws, regulations, practice standards, and guidelines. Can be written any time after CNO confirms applicant status — including during the application review period. Must be paid for and completed within 30 days of fee payment; can be retaken as needed. No expiry on the result. Target completion: 2027-03-15.

steps.title: Police Criminal Record Check (Sterling Backcheck)
steps.detail: Obtain a police criminal record check exclusively through Sterling Backcheck (the only provider CNO accepts). This check is valid for six months from issue. Do NOT order it too early — if it expires before CNO's registration decision it must be redone. Recommended order date: 2027-03-01 (targeting a result by 2027-03-15, valid until 2027-09-15, which covers the anticipated registration decision). CNO recommends getting it near the end of the process, after the application is submitted.

steps.title: NCLEX-RN Examination
steps.detail: National licensure examination administered by NCSBN. Aida must first receive eligibility confirmation from CNO before registering with NCSBN to sit the exam. After CNO declares eligibility (expected 2027-04-01), schedule and write the NCLEX-RN. Target exam date: 2027-05-01. Passing the NCLEX-RN is the final clinical competency gate before CNO issues the certificate of registration.

steps.title: CNO Certificate of Registration Issued
steps.detail: Upon successful completion of all requirements — ECA, language proficiency, evidence of practice, TTP, jurisprudence exam, criminal record check, NCLEX-RN, and valid authorization to work — CNO issues Aida's certificate of registration as a Registered Nurse in Ontario. Estimated issuance: 2027-06-01. Aida may then practice as an RN in Ontario.

logEntry.text:
Pathway built for Aida Torres — internationally educated Registered Nurse (Philippines) seeking CNO registration in Ontario, Canada. Today is 2026-09-14. The College of Nurses of Ontario (CNO) regulates RN practice in Ontario.

Estimated timeframe: approximately 9–12 months from today, with a realistic registration target of 2027-06-01.

Plan summary (10 steps in dependency order):
1. Authorization to Work — confirm valid immigration status immediately; CNO cannot issue a certificate to someone without valid work authorization.
2. Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) — submit to WES, ICAS, or ICES (BCIT) by 2026-10-01; CNO receipt expected 2027-02-01. This gates the registration application.
3. Language Proficiency Test — write IELTS Academic, CELBAN, or OET by 2026-11-01; result valid until 2028-11-01, safely covering the 2027 registration decision. CRITICAL: the test must remain valid (within 24 months) at the CNO decision date, not just at application.
4. Evidence of Practice — collect employer and regulator verification forms covering RN practice up to at least 2024-09-14.
5. Transition to Practice (TTP) — as a newly arrived internationally educated nurse, Aida will most likely need a CNO-approved TTP course; target completion 2027-03-01 (valid five years to 2032-03-01).
6. CNO Registration Application — submit by 2027-02-15 once CNO has received the ECA report.
7. Jurisprudence Examination — complete the open-book online exam by 2027-03-15 after CNO confirms applicant status.
8. Police Criminal Record Check (Sterling Backcheck only) — order 2027-03-01, valid six months to 2027-09-15; ordering too early risks expiry before the registration decision.
9. NCLEX-RN — write after receiving CNO eligibility confirmation; target 2027-05-01.
10. CNO Certificate of Registration — estimated issuance 2027-06-01 upon all requirements satisfied.

Key risk to watch: the language test's 24-month validity window. If the ECA or TTP timelines slip and the registration decision is delayed past 2028-11-01 (if testing on 2026-11-01), Aida would need to retest. Monitor actively.

logEntry.text:
⚠️ DELAY ALERT — two steps marked at-risk as of 2026-09-14.

COLLISION IDENTIFIED: ECA processing delay (Step 2) → Police Criminal Record Check expiry before registration decision (Step 8).

ROOT CAUSE: The ECA submitted on 2026-10-01 has taken 7 months rather than the planned 4 months, meaning CNO will not receive the report until 2027-05-01 (3 months later than the 2027-02-01 target). This is within the documented worst-case range when providers request supplementary documents from Philippine institutions.

CASCADE: The 3-month ECA slip pushes every downstream date by approximately the same amount:
  • CNO application: 2027-05-15 (was 2027-02-15)
  • Jurisprudence exam: 2027-06-15 (was 2027-03-15)
  • NCLEX-RN eligibility: 2027-07-15 (was 2027-04-01)
  • NCLEX-RN exam: 2027-08-15 (was 2027-05-01)
  • Registration decision / certificate: 2027-09-15 (was 2027-06-01)

ACUTE EXPIRY COLLISION — Step 8 (Criminal Record Check): The check was planned to be ordered on 2027-03-01, producing a result valid for 6 months until 2027-09-01. The revised registration decision date of 2027-09-15 falls 14 days AFTER that expiry. If ordered as planned, CNO will reject the expired check and require a new one — adding further delay and a second Sterling Backcheck fee.

CONCRETE RECOMMENDATION for Step 8: Delay the Sterling Backcheck order from 2027-03-01 to 2027-04-01. A check ordered 2027-04-01 will be returned by approximately 2027-04-15 and remains valid until 2027-10-15 — covering the revised decision date of 2027-09-15 with a full month of buffer.

NO OTHER COLLISIONS: Language proficiency (CELBAN taken 2026-11-01, valid until 2028-11-01) is safe through the revised decision date. TTP validity (5 years from completion) and Evidence of Practice three-year lookback are unaffected by the shift.

ACTION THIS WEEK: Contact the ECA provider immediately to confirm all Philippine nursing transcripts and supporting documents have been received and are under review. If the provider cannot confirm imminent completion, explore whether an NNAS expedited report via CGFNS/TruMerit is accepted by CNO as a substitute (CNO's approved-ECA page confirms it still accepts these) — that pathway may recover some lost time.

The ECA report is required for Express Entry / Permanent Residence applications and confirms Canadian equivalency. logEntry.text: Software Engineering is NOT a licensed or regulated profession in Ontario, Canada. Wei Chen does not need a practice licence to work as a software engineer — this is a deliberate finding, not an oversight. No regulatory body governs the title 'Software Engineer' in Ontario (only the reserved title 'Professional Engineer / P.Eng.' is restricted, governed by PEO, and is a separate voluntary pursuit). The steps below cover work-authorization only: an Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) for immigration purposes (e.g. Express Entry / PR) and portfolio or reference verification for employer onboarding. Estimated timeframe from 2026-09-14: ECA approximately 2–3 months (by approx. 2026-12-14), then employment search and employer verification on hire. No licensing exam, no registration, no regulated bridge program required.

steps.title: Select the correct Anerkennungsbehörde (State Recognition Authority)
steps.detail: As a Croatian-trained nurse, identify the Bundesland where you intend to work and locate its specific Anerkennungsbehörde. Germany has 16 federal states, each with its own authority and slightly different procedures. Use the Recognition Finder at anerkennung-in-deutschland.de to confirm the right office. Do this before submitting any documents. Target completion: 2026-10-14.

steps.title: Antrag auf Anerkennung — Equivalency Assessment Application
steps.detail: Submit your formal application for credential equivalency under the Pflegeberufegesetz (PflBG) to your chosen state authority. You must provide certified copies AND certified German translations of: nursing diploma, full academic transcripts, CV, and proof of professional registration in Croatia. The authority will compare your training to the German standard. Expect a decision (Bescheid) within approximately 3–4 months. Estimated submission: 2026-10-14; estimated decision: 2027-01-14. Note: approximately 85% of non-EU applicants receive a Defizitbescheid (gaps found), triggering Step 5.

steps.title: Begin German Language Learning — Target B2 CEFR + Fachsprachprüfung
steps.detail: Enrol in a German language course immediately — this can run in parallel with Step 2 and should not be delayed. You need two things: (1) a general German B2 certificate (e.g. Goethe-Zertifikat B2 or telc Deutsch B2) and (2) the Fachsprachprüfung, a specialist medical/nursing language exam administered by your Bundesland's Medical or Nursing Chamber. Under the Recognition Partnership (in force since 2024-03-01) you may enter Germany and begin working at A2/B1 level, but full licence issuance requires B2. Both certificates must be valid at the point the authority makes its final registration decision. Estimated B2 certificate: 2027-03-14 (assuming starting from A2/B1 level); Fachsprachprüfung: 2027-06-14.

steps.title: Police Clearance (Führungszeugnis) + Health Suitability Certificate
steps.detail: Obtain: (1) an extended police clearance certificate (erweitertes Führungszeugnis) — apply via the Einwohnermeldeamt or German Embassy in Croatia; (2) a medical certificate confirming health suitability to practise as required under Section 2 PflBG. Both documents must be current at the point of the final registration decision. Do not obtain these too early — request them approximately 2–3 months before your file is complete. Target request date: 2027-04-14; must be valid at final decision estimated 2027-07-14.

steps.title: Adaptation Course or Knowledge Test (Anpassungslehrgang / Kenntnisprüfung) — if Defizitbescheid issued
steps.detail: This step is conditional on the outcome of Step 2. If the authority issues a Defizitbescheid (deficit notice — expected for most non-EU applicants including those from Croatia), you must either: (a) complete a supervised adaptation placement (Anpassungslehrgang) at an approved German healthcare facility, typically 6–12 months, OR (b) pass a comprehensive knowledge test (Kenntnisprüfung). You choose which route. If a Defizitbescheid is issued circa 2027-01-14, an adaptation course would run approximately 2027-02-14 to 2027-08-14. This step is a hard prerequisite for Step 6 and must be completed before the licence is granted.

steps.title: Erlaubnis zum Führen der Berufsbezeichnung — Professional Licence (Pflegefachperson)
steps.detail: Once all prior steps are satisfied — equivalency confirmed (or deficits resolved via Step 5), B2 general language certificate, Fachsprachprüfung, police clearance, and health suitability — the state authority grants the Approbation or Berufserlaubnis as Pflegefachperson (licence to use the professional title and practise as a registered nurse in Germany). The authority targets a decision within 3–4 months of a complete file. Estimated complete-file submission: 2027-06-14; estimated licence grant: 2027-09-14 (approximately 12 months from today 2026-09-14, assuming a Defizitbescheid is issued and the adaptation route is taken).

logEntry.text:
Pathway built for Lena Novak — Registered Nurse (Croatia → Germany), reference date 2026-09-14.

Nursing is a regulated profession in Germany governed by the Pflegeberufegesetz (PflBG). The competent authority is the state-level Anerkennungsbehörde in whichever Bundesland Lena will work. There is no single national licensing exam; instead, the authority conducts a direct equivalency assessment of the Croatian qualification against the German standard.

Key facts driving this pathway:
• Croatia is an EU member state, but the automatic mutual-recognition route for nurses under EU Directive 2005/36/EC requires specific minimum training hours. If Lena's diploma meets those thresholds, the process may be faster (~3 months total). The pathway below assumes the more common scenario where a formal assessment is required and a Defizitbescheid is issued (~85% of non-EU-route applicants).
• Language: B2 general German PLUS the Fachsprachprüfung (specialist medical/nursing language exam) are both mandatory and must be valid at the registration decision date — not merely at application. Under the Recognition Partnership (since 2024-03-01), Lena may enter Germany and work under supervision from A2/B1 level while completing her language training.
• No separate licensing exam (no Staatsexamen equivalent) — the bridging requirement is the Anpassungslehrgang (adaptation course) or Kenntnisprüfung if deficits are found.

Estimated realistic timeline (if Defizitbescheid issued):
• Step 1 — Identify authority: by 2026-10-14
• Step 2 — Submit equivalency application: 2026-10-14; decision: ~2027-01-14
• Step 3 — B2 certificate: ~2027-03-14; Fachsprachprüfung: ~2027-06-14 (running in parallel)
• Step 4 — Police clearance + health certificate: request 2027-04-14
• Step 5 — Adaptation course (if required): 2027-02-14 to ~2027-08-14
• Step 6 — Licence granted: estimated 2027-09-14

Total estimated time to licence: approximately 12 months from 2026-09-14. If the EU automatic-recognition route applies, this could shorten to 3–4 months. Lena should engage a qualified German immigration/recognition advisor and contact her target Bundesland authority early to clarify which route applies.

steps.detail: Submit your Brazilian nursing transcripts, diploma, and licensure documents to CGFNS (now operating as TruMerit) for a course-by-course evaluation of your foreign nursing education. This is a mandatory gateway before NYSED will assess your NCLEX-RN eligibility. Typical processing time is 4–6 months. Target submission: 2026-09-14; expected completion: 2027-03-14.

steps.title: English Proficiency — TOEFL iBT
steps.detail: Because your nursing education was conducted in Portuguese (Brazil), NYSED requires evidence of English proficiency via the TOEFL iBT. The score must remain valid (24-month window) at the point of NYSED's registration decision. Recommended test date: 2026-11-01, giving a validity window of 2026-11-01 to 2028-11-01 — well past the projected licensure decision of 2027-07-14. Scores are sent directly to NYSED.

steps.title: NYSED NCLEX-RN Eligibility Application
steps.detail: Once your CGFNS CES evaluation is complete (expected 2027-03-14), apply to NYSED for authorization to take the NCLEX-RN. NYSED reviews your CES report and TOEFL score and issues an Authorization to Test (ATT) via Pearson VUE. Submit application ~2027-03-14; allow 4–8 weeks for eligibility determination.

steps.title: NCLEX-RN Examination
steps.detail: Sit the NCLEX-RN through Pearson VUE after receiving your ATT. This is the national licensure examination required for RN registration in all U.S. states including New York. Schedule as soon as your ATT is issued. Projected exam window: 2027-05-14 to 2027-06-14. Results are reported to NYSED automatically.

steps.title: NYSED Licensure Application & First Registration
steps.detail: After passing the NCLEX-RN (projected pass ~2027-06-14), NYSED processes your full licensure and issues your New York RN licence and first registration. Confirm that your TOEFL score is still on file (validity: 2028-11-01 ✓). Projected licensure decision: 2027-07-14. You may then begin practising as a Registered Nurse in New York State.

logEntry.text:
Pathway built for Mateus Silva — Brazil-trained Registered Nurse targeting licensure in New York State.

Regulator: NYSED Office of the Professions. Gateway body: CGFNS (now TruMerit).

The pathway has 5 ordered steps with the following dependencies:
• Step 1 (CGFNS CES) is the critical gateway — NYSED will not assess NCLEX eligibility without it. Submit immediately; expect completion ~2027-03-14.
• Step 2 (TOEFL iBT) is required because Mateus trained in Brazil (Portuguese-medium education). Take the exam by 2026-11-01 to secure a 24-month validity window (valid until 2028-11-01), which safely covers the projected NYSED registration decision of 2027-07-14.
• Step 3 (NYSED eligibility application) can begin once Step 1 is complete (~2027-03-14), and requires the TOEFL score to be on file.
• Step 4 (NCLEX-RN via Pearson VUE) requires an Authorization to Test (ATT) from NYSED. Projected exam window: 2027-05-14 to 2027-06-14.
• Step 5 (NYSED licence & first registration) follows NCLEX passage; projected decision: 2027-07-14.

Estimated total timeline from today (2026-09-14) to licensure: approximately 10 months, with the CGFNS CES evaluation being the longest single bottleneck (~4–6 months). Beginning both Step 1 and Step 2 concurrently as soon as possible is strongly recommended.
